plugin.name: Dashlane
plugin.description: Import and sync logins from Dashlane collections into Termix credentials.

connect.title: Connect Dashlane
connect.intro: Termix reads your vault with a service device key. Make one on any computer with the Dashlane CLI, then paste it here.
connect.keyHint: The key includes your master password. It is stored encrypted on the server and never shown again. Remove the device in Dashlane to revoke it.

account.title: Account
account.disconnectBody: The device key is deleted from Termix. Credentials that were imported stay unless you remove them too.

collections.title: Collections to import
collections.hint: Logins in these collections become Termix credentials, in a folder named after the collection.
collections.empty: No collections in this vault. Make one in Dashlane, then press Refresh.
collections.missing: Not in the vault any more
collections.removeMissing: Delete credentials that leave these collections
collections.removeMissingHint: Only credentials this plugin imported are ever deleted.

sync.title: Sync
sync.manualOnly: Automatic sync is off. An admin can turn it on in Settings.
sync.needsNewerTermix: Automatic sync needs Termix 26.10.2 or newer. Until then, press Sync now to sync.
sync.skippedHint: Logins without a password are skipped.

imported.title: Imported credentials
imported.empty: Nothing imported yet. Pick collections and press Sync now.

error.load: Could not load the Dashlane connection

use.title: Use Dashlane
use.description: Connect a Dashlane account and import its logins as credentials.

syncIntervalMinutes.label: Sync interval (minutes)
syncIntervalMinutes.description: How often every connected account is synced. 0 turns automatic sync off, so people sync by hand.
